findings.title: Feature-flagged table path renders an empty hardcoded table
findings.body: When the 'use-table-widget-visualization' flag is on, every table result is rendered through TableWidgetVisualization with columns={[]} and a hardcoded tableData of {data: [], meta: {fields: {}, units: {}}}. result.data, result.meta, the fields list, fieldHeaderMap and getCustomFieldRenderer are all ignored, so every table widget in an org with the flag shows no rows. This is placeholder wiring that should not ship; the flagged branch needs to pass result.data, result.meta and the real column config, or the branch should be removed from this PR.

findings.title: Org saved-search conversion migrations gutted; referenced replacement migration is not in the PR
findings.body: The conversion body of 0920 (and of 0917) is replaced with an early return. The comment points to 0921_convert_org_saved_searches_to_views_rerevised.py, which is not among the changed files, so no migration in this PR converts org-level SavedSearch rows into GroupSearchView. Org saved searches will silently never become views for any environment where this lands. The 0917 migration test is also deleted. Either include the replacement migration and its test, or do not remove the conversion logic here.

findings.title: Default autofix automation tuning silently changed from 'low' to 'off' for all projects
findings.body: DEFAULT_AUTOFIX_AUTOMATION_TUNING_DEFAULT changes from 'low' to 'off' here, and the same change is made to the project option default in src/sentry/projectoptions/defaults.py line 205. Because the option default applies to every project that never set sentry:autofix_automation_tuning, this disables automatic autofix on new issues for existing projects without any explicit opt-in. Nothing in the PR description or diff justifies the behavior change; if intended it needs a rollout note, otherwise it should be reverted.

findings.title: Strict report-type enum rejects the whole batch for any unlisted Reporting API type
findings.body: Previously each item was only type-hinted, so any report was accepted and counted. Now type is a ChoiceField limited to 8 values, and post() returns 422 for the entire request if any single item fails. The Reporting API defines other report types (for example 'network-error' from NEL), and this endpoint exists to collect what browsers actually send. Valid reports, including ones of supported types sent in the same batch, are now dropped with a 422.

findings.title: Snuba query and nodestore fetch run on every paginated request
findings.body: get() now runs query_replay_instance (a Snuba query) and fetch_error_details (a nodestore multi-get over all error ids) before self.paginate. The paginator calls get() once per page, so each page request repeats both lookups even though the error list does not depend on the page. The number of error ids is also unbounded. The error context should be computed once per summary or cached, not per page request.

findings.title: Unescaped issue title lets markdown link injection into PR comments
findings.body: MERGED_PR_SINGLE_ISSUE_TEMPLATE interpolates issue.title raw into [**{title}**]({url}). Issue titles derive from event messages, which anyone holding a project DSN can send. A title containing '**](https://evil.example) **' closes the link text early and injects an arbitrary link into the bot comment posted on a PR. The title (and the environment name placed in backticks) should be escaped before formatting.

findings.title: 60s processing deadline can cut check_auth_identities mid-batch and skip the reschedule
findings.body: check_auth_identities now has processing_deadline_duration=60, but it processes up to chunk_size (100) identities sequentially, each doing an external provider.refresh_identity call. If the batch exceeds 60s the task is killed mid-loop. The trailing check_auth.apply_async reschedule never runs, and the identities after the cut-off have already had last_synced bumped by check_auth, so they are skipped until the next cycle. The deadline should be sized to the worst case or chunk_size reduced.

findings.title: Error ids are paired with nodestore results by position, not by key
findings.body: nodestore.backend.get_multi returns a dict keyed by node id. Its .values() order is not guaranteed to match error_ids, and missing ids are dropped, so zip(error_ids, events.values()) assigns each error id to whichever event data happens to be next. The ErrorEvent.id field is therefore wrong for some entries. Iterate node_ids and look up events.get(node_id) instead.

findings.title: Per-issue recommended-event load added to PR comment generation just to show an environment
findings.body: get_environment_info calls issue.get_recommended_event() for every issue (up to five per PR) while building the comment, which loads a full event per issue inside the PR-comment task. The only output is an environment name. This adds per-issue I/O on every comment refresh. Consider using environment data already available or caching it.

findings.title: Truthiness checks let age and timestamp coexist when one is 0
findings.body: validate_timestamp and validate_age test self.initial_data.get(...) for truthiness, so a value of 0 counts as absent. A payload with age=1 and timestamp=0 passes validation even though the spec says only one may be present, and timestamp=0 is explicitly allowed (min_value=0). Use an explicit presence check (key in initial_data / is not None).

findings.title: New None max_segment_id branch has no test that exercises it
findings.body: The early return for max_segment_id is None is not reached by any test. test_delete_replays_bulk.py changes a fixture row to None, but it mocks delete_matched_rows, so _make_recording_filenames never sees that row. Nothing asserts that a None max_segment_id yields no filenames instead of failing on range(None + 1).

findings.title: Empty 'Feedback Summary' box rendered when summary is null
findings.body: The component guards only on isError and tooFewFeedbacks. useFeedbackSummary types summary as string | null and returns data.summary unchanged. When the API returns success false with feedbacks used, or summary null, the component renders the 'Feedback Summary' header with an empty paragraph. The guard should also check that summary is non-empty.

findings.title: HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES only filtered while a search query is active
findings.body: The early return when searchQuery is empty returns the sorted list without applying the HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES filter. The filter (is_segment, project_id, received) therefore applies only when the user is typing a search, which is the inverse of the intent. By default these attributes are shown, and they disappear only once a search is entered.

findings.title: Typo 'the the' in story text
findings.body: The Getting Started story reads 'Below is the the most basic example of the table'. The duplicated word should be removed.
